messages:
Nora (Design): Dropped a new Figma frame 12; focus: axis label wrapping + how we surface huge outliers. link: https://figma.com/file/abcd (mock)
Sam (Frontend): Quick scan 12; axis labels truncate at narrow widths, maybe allow two-line wrap and ellipsis with tooltip on hover/focus. Also CSS-wise we can use text-overflow: ellipsis but that's single-line only.
Daria (Product): For non-technical users, label 'Units: auto (full value on hover)' might be confusing. Suggest 'Units (auto) 12; full value in tooltip'.
Ethan (DataViz): Outlier handling options: 'show', 'winsorize (cap at X percentile)', 'annotate (draw marker and keep scale)'. Winsorize avoids compressing the whole series.
Rhea (Accessibility): Make sure tooltip content is accessible (aria-describedby) and legend items are buttons. If we allow wrap, ensure focus order predictable.
Sam (Frontend): Small config sketch:
```
const chartOptions = {
  units: 'auto',
  axis: { wrap: true, maxLines: 2 },
  outliers: { mode: 'winsorize', percentile: 99 },
  smoothing: { type: 'ema', alpha: 0.2 }
};
```
Ethan (DataViz): On smoothing: EMA vs simple moving average 12; EMA better for streaming as it doesn't need window buffer. Defaults? I'd pick EMA with low alpha, off by default.
Nora (Design): UX question: should we show a small meter in the legend for series density/spikiness? It could suggest 'high variance' and propose actions.
Daria (Product): I like auto suggestions but keep non-intrusive. Maybe an inline suggestion row: 'Series variance high 12; try winsorizing or smoothing' with a small CTA 'Try'.
Rhea (Accessibility): The 'Try' CTA must be keyboard operable and explain what it will do (aria-label / aria-describedby). Also color alone can't indicate suggestion state.
Sam (Frontend): Edge: streaming charts + winsorize 12; need deterministic online percentile. We can use t-digest or reservoir sampling for approximations.
Ethan (DataViz): Also for compact units (k / M) expose a full-precision value in tooltip and include the full number in screen-reader text.
Nora (Design): I'll mock the inline suggestion row, two-line axis labels, and a small legend spikiness meter. Will upload in ~30m.
